OCR model attribution for the portable Windows package

The bundled ONNX files originate from the rapidocr 3.9.2 Python package.
RapidOCR's project README identifies the upstream model weights as
PaddleOCR models, copyrighted by Baidu and/or the respective PaddleOCR
rights holders. It states that the upstream and converted ONNX models are
distributed under Apache License 2.0. The license text is in RapidOCR-LICENSE.

Bundled model identities (SHA-256):
PP-OCRv6_det_small.onnx: 090f04abcd9d9a7498bc4ebf677e4cb9bdce1fe4197ddb7e529f1ef44e1ff94f
PP-OCRv6_rec_small.onnx: 6f327246b50388f3c176ae304bd95767ea6dc0c9ae92153ef8cbe210b3c14884
ch_ppocr_mobile_v2.0_cls_mobile.onnx: e47acedf663230f8863ff1ab0e64dd2d82b838fceb5957146dab185a89d6215c
